newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN WINS AT IMOLA TO EXTEND LEAD.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN WINS AT IMOLA TO EXTEND LEAD.

text.p: Australia's Michael Doohan claimed his seventh success in eight outings when he won the San Marino 500cc motorcycling Grand Prix on Sunday.
The defending champion, riding a Honda, beat Japanese riders Nobuatsu Aoki and Takuma Aoki into second and third places.
The victory, his second in a row at Imola, extends Doohan's lead at the top of the world championship standings to a seemingly invincible 93 points over team mate Alex Criville of Spain.
Criville did not race on Sunday due to injuries sustained at last weekend's Dutch Grand Prix.
Aoki, who led Doohan for part of Sunday's race after starting fourth on the grid, remains third overall.
